title: Cale Comes to the Noodle Stand

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: If it isn't my favorite noodle master. How are you my friend?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it isn't my favorite noodle master. How are you my friend?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Oh, well, this is awkward. I'm Cale. I've been coming to the stand for a while now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, well, this is awkward. I'm Cale. I've been coming to the stand for a while now.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Yeah! I know, I have one of those faces and you probably see hundreds of them every day with how good the food Banor and them sling is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah! I know, I have one of those faces and you probably see hundreds of them every day with how good the food Banor and them sling is.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: I am what I am. I'll be good when I get some grub in me. Looking forward to what Banor and the crew cook up today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am what I am. I'll be good when I get some grub in me. Looking forward to what Banor and the crew cook up today.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: You're so funny! I really liked the hybrid strawberry and synthetic chamomile I tried the other day. Hey, that reminds me, I saw the health inspector skulking around the other day. Better watch out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're so funny! I really liked the hybrid strawberry and synthetic chamomile I tried the other day. Hey, that reminds me, I saw the health inspector skulking around the other day. Better watch out.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: For sure. I mean, they couldn't be coming for Thaddeus's place. There's no way something would be going on there. You all do the best work. Better than the corps!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For sure. I mean, they couldn't be coming for Thaddeus's place. There's no way something would be going on there. You all do the best work. Better than the corps!

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Sorry, that was over the top. I gotta rein it in sometimes. I know. Stupid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, that was over the top. I gotta rein it in sometimes. I know. Stupid.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Yeah. No worries. I get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. No worries. I get it.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Oh—shit—really? I'm sorry. I didn't mean to... Well, I hope I'll see you round lunch time!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh—shit—really? I'm sorry. I didn't mean to... Well, I hope I'll see you round lunch time!

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: You make it easy. I mean your food does. Shit. Ah, don't mind me. I'll swing by the stand soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You make it easy. I mean your food does. Shit. Ah, don't mind me. I'll swing by the stand soon.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Surviving is, well, the only thing we can do. Some say it's insufficient but when it's the only thing you can manage what are you supposed to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Surviving is, well, the only thing we can do. Some say it's insufficient but when it's the only thing you can manage what are you supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Really? When have they ever done anything to help us?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? When have they ever done anything to help us?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Who are we gonna get to help? MedSynge? That Corp is a plague on this city. I told you what they did to me right? What they did to my family?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are we gonna get to help? MedSynge? That Corp is a plague on this city. I told you what they did to me right? What they did to my family?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: They enrolled her in that clinical trial. Promised—fucking promised—there would be no charge if the trial failed. And guess what? It failed. My mother never left that hospital, but the invoices sure as hell did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They enrolled her in that clinical trial. Promised—fucking promised—there would be no charge if the trial failed. And guess what? It failed. My mother never left that hospital, but the invoices sure as hell did.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: I know. My poor mother. And not only that, but due to a technicality they refused to pay us for participating in the clinical trial.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. My poor mother. And not only that, but due to a technicality they refused to pay us for participating in the clinical trial.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: For sure. Now, here I am: sans family, aside from Meo, my little kittie friend, and well, you I guess. I mean I'd consider us friends, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For sure. Now, here I am: sans family, aside from Meo, my little kittie friend, and well, you I guess. I mean I'd consider us friends, right?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Thanks. I'll swing by for lunch or something real soon. Get that menu in shape for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks. I'll swing by for lunch or something real soon. Get that menu in shape for me.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: I know. I'm the one who said it. Only because I've been told it over and over again. If you have any ideas on how to use it for my benefit, I'm all ears.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. I'm the one who said it. Only because I've been told it over and over again. If you have any ideas on how to use it for my benefit, I'm all ears.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: I believe you. You wouldn't lie to me, one of your favorite customers. You just have a lot going on and probably could use a break, you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe you. You wouldn't lie to me, one of your favorite customers. You just have a lot going on and probably could use a break, you know?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: You and me both, my friend. You and me both.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You and me both, my friend. You and me both.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Ha! That would be the day. I don't need to help the drug lords pad the Corp's bottom line. No thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! That would be the day. I don't need to help the drug lords pad the Corp's bottom line. No thank you.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Eh, I'm sure I'll figure something out. Until then, least there's good food being served. Catch you later for lunch or something. Try not to forget my name again... Sorry, that was dumb. Ignore me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, I'm sure I'll figure something out. Until then, least there's good food being served. Catch you later for lunch or something. Try not to forget my name again... Sorry, that was dumb. Ignore me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doing okay, you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doing okay, you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Eh, just trying to survive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, just trying to survive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do I know you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I know you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course! Cale!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course! Cale!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Noodles, like time, heals all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Noodles, like time, heals all.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Cale.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, Cale.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Slimy bastards.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Slimy bastards.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Always love to hear that. You're too kind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Always love to hear that. You're too kind.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Always love to hear that. You're too kind.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Always love to hear that. You're too kind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's cool, Cale. No worries.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's cool, Cale. No worries.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I probably should get going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I probably should get going.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If only we could get the corps to actually help us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If only we could get the corps to actually help us.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If only we could get the corps to actually help us.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If only we could get the corps to actually help us.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's kind of the point, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's kind of the point, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's kind of the point, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's kind of the point, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A hundred times.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A hundred times.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, but I bet you're going to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, but I bet you're going to.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, but I bet you're going to.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, but I bet you're going to.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What'd they do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What'd they do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's horrible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's horrible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a load of moldy mushrooms.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a load of moldy mushrooms.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's a load of moldy mushrooms.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's a load of moldy mushrooms.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bastards.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bastards.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course, Cale.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course, Cale.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can be here when I can, but I got a business to run.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can be here when I can, but I got a business to run.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can be here when I can, but I got a business to run.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can be here when I can, but I got a business to run.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You do have one of those faces.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do have one of those faces.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You do have one of those faces.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You do have one of those faces.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I remember you. I swear. Long day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I remember you. I swear. Long day.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I remember you. I swear. Long day.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I remember you. I swear. Long day.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Could smuggle drugs or something. Blend into the crowd.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could smuggle drugs or something. Blend into the crowd.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Could smuggle drugs or something. Blend into the crowd.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Could smuggle drugs or something. Blend into the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I got nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got nothing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fair point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fair point.
